headline: J. Cole gives fans more insight into the creative process behind his new Dreamer sneaker.
body: J. Cole gives fans more insight into the creative process behind his new Dreamer sneaker. Showing a special custom made insole that can be worn for extra comfort and durability. He goes on to say how had he not produced the shoe independently he probably wouldn’t have been able to produce such a high quality shoe.
